Package com.societegenerale.failover.dashboard.metrics.source.sharedstore

Interface SnapshotStore

All Known Implementing Classes:
SnapshotStoreInmemory, SnapshotStoreJdbc
public interface SnapshotStore
Where pushed per-instance ClusterSnapshots are held for the shared-store tier. The default SnapshotStoreInmemory keeps the latest snapshot per instance in memory; a @ConditionalOnMissingBean lets a consumer supply a durable (JDBC) or distributed (Redis/Hazelcast) implementation without touching the source or UI.

Counts are never dropped from the aggregate. Every instance contributes its last-known values, so the dashboard never silently zeroes a quiet or crashed peer, and implementations must apply the SnapshotBaseline carry-forward so a peer restart (counter reset) never shrinks the cluster totals. An implementation may retire instances not seen within a retention window — removing them from allInstances() to keep the list bounded and readable — but their counts must keep contributing through retiredAggregate(). Staleness of live entries is visible through the per-instance lastSeenEpochMs timestamp shown in the Instances tab.

Author:
Anand Manissery

    • allInstances

      List<InstanceMetrics> allInstances()
      All non-retired per-instance entries (id + last-seen + summary). LiveStatus is set to UNKNOWN by the store — callers enrich it from a HeartbeatStore when liveness tracking is enabled.

      Stale instances retain their last-known metric values so the cluster aggregate does not silently drop when a peer crashes; those past the retention window move to retiredAggregate(). Per-instance staleness is visible through lastSeenEpochMs.

      Returns:
      one InstanceMetrics per known instance, with liveStatus = UNKNOWN

    • configEntries

      default List<ConfigEntry> configEntries()
      The @Failover configuration, merged across every active instance (config is expected identical cluster-wide; when instances disagree the most recently pushed value per name wins).
      Returns:
      one ConfigEntry per distinct failover name; empty when nothing has been pushed yet
